argument: Define C_Z as the universal rank-d cyclotomic type-A KLR integer presentation, summed over its finite content set; base-change compatibility with the same presented algebra over every field is formal from tensor right exactness on free generators and relations

Integer coefficients and coefficient-1 dot/crossing rewriting in polynomial-representation Proof6.2 give spanning monomials tau_w x^a e(nu) without any division; fixed root degree has finite nu,w, crossing degrees bounded below and dot degrees positive, so each homogeneous C_Z,m is finitely generated over Z

Write each homogeneous abelian group as Z^{r_m} plus finite torsion. The actual regular-Hom norm theorem over Q, which requires no primitive e-th root, proves sum_m r_m=D=l^d d!, with finite rational support

For every prime p apply the same any-field norm to F_p (including p dividing e): dimension sum_m(r_m+t_m,p)=D, where t_m,p counts cyclic p-primary torsion summands. All contributions are nonnegative and sum_m r_m=D, so each t_m,p is zero

Every degree is torsion-free, and degrees outside rational support are zero because they are finitely generated torsion groups whose every prime torsion count vanishes. Thus C_Z has finite support and is finite free, separately by each content

Inject C_Z into K tensor C_Z using freeness; identify K tensor C_Z with the KLR algebra over K and then by BK with the Hecke algebra. Its image is exactly the integer subring generated by named KLR images, since C_Z is generated by these elements; this identifies the universal order with the stated lattice

For every CP field F, tensoring the order identified above produces the KLR algebra over F by formal presentation base change, then the actual BK isomorphism gives H_F. All generator maps and degrees agree, proving the stated graded isomorphisms without choosing a rational Hecke root of unity or assuming reduction relations survive
